salary_details.details: Assistant Director: Rs. 40,500/- per month as Job Trainee emoluments.

selection_process: Objective Type Screening Test / Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test Personality Test

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the HPPSC Assistant Director, Group-A (Job Trainee) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 03-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HPPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (HPPSC) for filling positions in the state government sector.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in HPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The commission is offering 3 vacancies for the post of Assistant Director, Group-A (Job Trainee) in Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form and pay the application fee is 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Forensic Science / Chemistry / Bio-Chemistry or Pharmacy / M.S.(Pharm.) / M.Pharm. along with 7 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 45 years of age, with upper age relaxation applicable for reserved categories of Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600.00 for all applicable categories, payable through online payment modes like debit card, credit card, or UPI.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary/stipend for the job trainee post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive fixed monthly emoluments amounting to Rs. 40,500/- per month during their engagement period.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Objective Type Screening Test, a Descriptive Subject Aptitude Test (SAT), and a final Personality Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official HPPSC website at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any negative marking in the exam?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a negative marking of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for wrong answers, unattempted answers, or multiple answers.
